原文:
It provided better overall sound for my anemic older Vizio TV. However, several issues make it quite different from other "soundbar" types. If you program your Comcast remote to use the Zvox functions,it hijacks other functions that control your TV! I have my headphones connected to the audio out, and now I cant use my Comcast remote to control them or any normal Vizio audio functions without turning off the Zvox manually. OL barely works as commercials are still as loud as ever. I still have to turn it up to get a decent level on shows,and theres quite a bump up in sound between 17-18!
No codes to use with other universal remotes? Seems the Zvox people decided once it was hooked up no one would ever switch back to their TV sound for any functions. If it worked seamlessly with my remote I'd give it 4 stars. Easier to stick to their weird remote.
中文翻译:
它为我那台老旧的Vizio电视提供了更好的整体音效。然而，有几个问题使它与其他类型的“条形音箱”相当不同。如果你将Comcast遥控器编程为使用Zvox功能，它会劫持控制电视的其他功能！我将耳机连接到音频输出，现在如果不手动关闭Zvox，我就无法使用Comcast遥控器控制它们或任何正常的Vizio音频功能。OL几乎不起作用，因为广告仍然和以前一样响。我仍然需要调高音量才能在节目中获得不错的音量水平，而且音量在17-18之间有一个相当大的跳跃！
没有代码可用于其他通用遥控器？似乎Zvox的人认为一旦连接上，就没人会为了任何功能切换回电视声音。如果它能与我的遥控器无缝配合，我会给它4星。更容易坚持使用他们奇怪的遥控器。

原文: Bulky but overall, has a good battery life. The sound could be much better, but it gets the task done til a better speaker can be purchased! If you are looking for a great clearness in sound, "This Speaker is Not It"!
中文翻译: 体积较大，但总体而言，电池续航不错。音质本可以好得多，但在买到更好的音箱之前，它能完成任务！如果你在寻找音质非常清晰的效果，“这款音箱不是那个选择”！

原文:
This radio gets good reception, though the sound quality is not superb. The tiny user manual offers a solution to poor sound quality, but that advice didn't work for me. Still, the sound is clear enough if you are listening to news or information.

My biggest complaint is that it's very hard to see what station you are on. The radio has a tuning dial, but the bar window showing your location is very hard to see, no matter what angle you view.

The other issue is that I'm not sure the radio ever fully charged. I plugged it in, and a red light came on, which I assumed meant it was charging. However, after a couple of hours, the light never changed. So I'm not sure if that is merely a power indicator, or whether it didn't charge, or if it's designed not to indicate its charge level.
中文翻译:
这台收音机接收效果不错，不过音质不算出色。小小的用户手册提供了一个解决音质不佳的方法，但那个建议对我没用。不过，如果你是在听新闻或信息类节目，声音还是足够清晰的。

我最大的不满是很难看清你正在收听哪个电台。收音机有一个调谐旋钮，但显示你位置的条形窗口非常难以看清，无论从哪个角度观看都是如此。

另一个问题是，我不确定这台收音机是否曾经完全充满电。我插上电源，一个红灯亮了，我以为这表示正在充电。然而，几个小时后，灯一直没有变化。所以我不确定那只是一个电源指示灯，还是它没有充电，或者它设计上就不显示充电水平。

原文: Scrappy device!!!! The static drives me up the wall using this device. I keep switching FM channels to get better reception but to no avail. I have stopped using it just for this reason. I cannot enjoy music using this device. I have to eventually get something different. I 100% will never recommend or trust to buy anything from this company. I wasted my money
中文翻译: 破烂设备！！！！使用这个设备时，静电声让我抓狂。我不断切换FM频道以获得更好的接收效果，但毫无用处。就因为这个原因，我已经停止使用它了。我无法用这个设备享受音乐。我最终得换个别的。我100%永远不会推荐或信任购买这家公司的任何东西。我浪费了我的钱

原文: The name suggests it’s from Japan; not so, made in China.  IMO, the quality falls short of expectations despite being a very user friendly unit with good features.  HDMI allows for an easy connect to homeTV, not generally found on most DVD players.  Cable not included.  At this price the sound is too tinny.  Maybe earbuds improves it?  I would recommend it if you don’t mind average, e.g. Chevrolet quality but if you want Japanese or BMW fit and finish level look elsewhere.
中文翻译: 这个名字暗示它来自日本；但并非如此，是中国制造。在我看来，尽管这是一个非常用户友好、功能不错的设备，但质量未达预期。HDMI可以轻松连接到家庭电视，这在大多数DVD播放器上通常没有。不包含线缆。在这个价格上，声音太单薄了。也许耳机能改善？如果你不介意一般水平，比如雪佛兰的质量，我会推荐它，但如果你想要日本或宝马级别的做工和质感，请另寻他处。

原文:
I feel since I have owned 10 months now, I can accurately review it. I have actually not had any issues with it. Since Sept, there have been 6 incidences that I needed it for. I ride my bike A LOT. The only thing I hate about it is using my phone to download the videos and using the wifi off the camera. It is extremely slow. So when I did need the videos for a police officer, I couldn't get them for him and he just told me to email them to him later. He had other more important things to do.

The videos are clear. The audio isn't so much unless I yell and that's only because the mic on the unit itself is far enough away. Im sure an external mic would help.
中文翻译:
我觉得既然我已经拥有它10个月了，我可以准确地评价它。实际上我并没有遇到任何问题。自9月以来，有6次我需要用到它。我经常骑自行车。我唯一讨厌的是用手机下载视频和使用相机的wifi。它非常慢。所以当我确实需要视频给警察时，我无法给他，他只是让我稍后通过电子邮件发送给他。他还有其他更重要的事情要做。

视频很清晰。音频就不那么清晰了，除非我大喊，那只是因为设备本身的麦克风距离足够远。我相信外接麦克风会有所帮助。

原文: They're ok for basic use perhaps.  Perhaps.  But they're really quite tinny sounding, and I quickly find it painful to listen to music playing through these speakers. To be clear, I'm not expecting the performance of my home stereo, I'm just comparing them to my other computer speakers -- they're much better.  So if you have a sensitive ear, you might wish to spend a bit more money and get a nicer pair.
中文翻译: 它们或许适合基本使用。也许吧。但它们听起来确实相当单薄刺耳，我很快发现用这些扬声器播放音乐听起来很痛苦。需要说明的是，我并不期望它们有我家音响的表现，我只是把它们和我其他的电脑扬声器比较——那些要好得多。所以如果你耳朵比较敏感，你可能希望多花点钱买一对更好的。

原文: [[VIDEOID:8fdfa5af6e5ae73eec07b05f1fcb77af]] I would give this 0 stars but I can’t. This is a huge waste of money. This speaker was really good at first but then it became almost muddled. A few weeks later, it broke completely. (See video) I have no idea why it changed.. keep looking elsewhere. This is a piece of crap.
中文翻译: 我本想给这个打0星，但做不到。这完全是浪费钱。这个音箱一开始真的很好，但后来声音几乎变得模糊不清。几周后，它彻底坏了。（见视频）我不知道为什么它变了……继续看别处吧。这就是个垃圾。

原文: Out of the box, these speakers are so cool! I love that I can spread them through a room for the surround sound and immersive experience. They charge as a unit or separately and are really fun to experiment with. The concept is fun and the sound delivers in certain genres, but on bass-heavy genres like club or hip hop they leave a little more to be desired. That said, I like to use these in my meditation room for chants and mantras so they perform well for me.
中文翻译: 开箱即用，这些音箱太酷了！我喜欢可以把它们分散在房间里，获得环绕声和沉浸式体验。它们可以作为一个整体充电，也可以单独充电，玩起来真的很有趣。这个概念很有趣，声音在某些音乐类型上表现不错，但在像俱乐部或嘻哈这种重低音类型上，它们就有点不尽如人意了。尽管如此，我喜欢在冥想室里用它们来播放诵经和咒语，所以它们对我来说表现很好。

原文: Not happy with the product. Not simple to use. Bluetooth connection keeps dropping. Poor sound quality. Not recommended. Much bettter Bluetooth speakers out there that sounds better and easier to use.
中文翻译: 对产品不满意。使用不简单。蓝牙连接不断断开。音质差。不推荐。市面上有更好的蓝牙音箱，音质更好，使用更方便。

原文: Older Mini-van radio died and did not want to spend a lot on the replacement. This unit was small (about a quarter size of the factory radio) with the adapter kit and wiring harness it was an easy install and great fit. In the Mini-van has good sound, plenty loud. If you crank it up it begins to distort, but that is as much the van speakers as anything. Still good clear plenty loud sound. Pulls in plenty of radio stations. Bluetooth was easy to connect on my Android, a bit more work on iPhone but terribly so, sound quality is acceptable both thorough built-in mic and speakers when making or receiving calls. Playing music through Bluetooth connection is nice and easy once you get your device paired. Volume knob requires a bit of turing to adjust volume, this could be a plus or minus since it allows finer control over volume, I prefer a quicker adjustment, but again could go either way. Takes some getting used to small buttons, an issue for me is the on/off button, you have to push it twice to turn it off, again like to volume knob could go either way as to good or bad. In my case if I am jamming out and need to lower the volume or turn it off it takes more time/effort than it really should. Not the end of the world but that combined with the very bright blue light at night knocked off a star from me. The light is fine during the day but driving at night it is distractingly bright. Have not used the USB port, Aux jack or the SD card slot yet. Overall for the price this is a very good bargain.
中文翻译: 旧的小型货车收音机坏了，不想花太多钱更换。这个设备很小（大约是原厂收音机的四分之一大小），配上适配器套件和线束，安装容易，贴合度很好。在小货车里音质不错，足够响亮。如果调大音量，开始失真，但这更多是货车扬声器的问题。仍然有清晰、足够响亮的声音。能收到很多电台。蓝牙在我的安卓上很容易连接，在iPhone上稍麻烦但也不是太糟，通话时通过内置麦克风和扬声器的音质都可以接受。一旦设备配对成功，通过蓝牙播放音乐既好又简单。音量旋钮需要转一点才能调节音量，这可能是优点也可能是缺点，因为它允许更精细的音量控制，我更喜欢快速调节，但这也可能各有所好。小按钮需要一些时间适应，对我来说一个问题是开/关按钮，需要按两次才能关闭，同样像音量旋钮一样，好坏各半。在我的情况下，如果我正在听音乐需要降低音量或关闭，花费的时间/精力比应该的要多。不是世界末日，但加上夜间非常亮的蓝光，让我扣了一星。白天灯光还好，但夜间驾驶时亮得让人分心。还没用过USB端口、辅助插孔或SD卡槽。总体而言，就价格来说，这是一个非常划算的选择。

原文: I have Echo devices of one kind or another in every room and have had others that I’ve decided to let go (original Echo and Echo Auto). They’ve all performed their smarthome duties acceptably well. My biggest complaint across the board is sound quality. Alexa always sounds like she’s talking to you from underneath a pile of pillows. Bass? Sure, on the Echo Show, at least. Treble? Nada. Sure, you can use the app’s “equalizer”... but it’d take an oscilloscope to detect the minuscule difference that makes in the sound quality. I’d given up on getting any more devices... until I saw a review of the Flex on Paul Hibbert’s YouTube channel... he liked it, but said (I think) that it sounded ‘trebly’. Trebly?! That’s a magic word to my ears. I ordered one up and found that it indeed sounds ‘trebly’ (call it tinny of you like) but who cares? Who seriously listens to music on these tiny little devices anyway?! I can understand what Alexa says now - all the plosives are there. I still wonder why Amazon can’t tune the rest of the Alexa enabled devices for better higher frequency clarity.
中文翻译: 我每个房间都有某种Echo设备，也曾经有过其他一些我决定放弃的设备（初代Echo和Echo Auto）。它们都还算称职地完成了智能家居的职责。我最大的抱怨普遍是音质。Alexa听起来总是像在一堆枕头下面跟你说话。低音？当然，至少在Echo Show上有。高音？没有。当然，你可以用应用程序的“均衡器”……但需要示波器才能检测到它对音质产生的微小变化。我已经放弃再买更多设备了……直到我在Paul Hibbert的YouTube频道上看到对Flex的评测……他喜欢它，但说（我想是）它听起来“高音突出”。高音突出？！对我来说这是魔法词。我订购了一个，发现它确实听起来“高音突出”（如果你愿意，可以称之为单薄刺耳），但谁在乎呢？反正谁会认真在这些小设备上听音乐呢？！我现在能听懂Alexa说的话了——所有的爆破音都在。我仍然想知道为什么亚马逊不能调整其他支持Alexa的设备以获得更好的高频清晰度。

原文: I received these 2 speakers for free because I pre- ordered the HTC -U11. I'm very disappointed because the volume is very low. I was expecting it to function like a loud speaker to play music from my phone or what ever other devices I have. Well at least I didn't waste my money.
中文翻译: 我免费收到了这两个扬声器，因为我预购了HTC -U11。我非常失望，因为音量非常低。我原本期望它能像扬声器一样，从我的手机或其他设备播放音乐。好吧，至少我没有浪费钱。

原文: Since attaching this to my granddaughters iPad, we have had issues with the volume control constantly going on and showing up on the screen. It almost like the buttons put too much pressure on the volume control and won't release. This is very frustrating for her, being autistic and frustrating for me to try and keep it off of there.
中文翻译: 自从把这个装到我孙女的iPad上后，我们就一直遇到音量控制不断弹出并显示在屏幕上的问题。几乎就像是按钮对音量控制施加了太大压力，无法释放。这对她来说非常令人沮丧，她是自闭症患者，而我也很难一直把它关掉。

原文:
I have a 1100.00 top of the line Samsung sound bar for my main TV, and while this can’t compare, it sure gives it a run for the money.

I can’t believe the clarity of the center speaker and all the features you get for 220.00. The sub woofer is the only downside I see so far as it is a bit muddy when you increase the base or raise the sub levels much past 50%. Other than that, this thing fills up a small bedroom with sound you would expect from a much more expensive system.

It’s still early, but as of right now, I am a believer.
中文翻译:
我有一台1100.00美元的高端三星条形音箱用于我的主电视，虽然这个无法相比，但它确实很有竞争力。

我简直不敢相信中置扬声器的清晰度以及你花220.00美元就能得到的所有功能。低音炮是我目前看到的唯一缺点，因为当你增加低音或将低音炮级别提高到超过50%时，它会有点浑浊。除此之外，这个东西用你期望从更昂贵系统得到的声音填满了一个小卧室。

现在还为时过早，但就目前而言，我是一个信徒。

原文: Love the unit however the speakers seem to be a bit muffled after just a month :(
中文翻译: 喜欢这个设备，但仅仅一个月后扬声器似乎有点闷 :(

原文: junk, loud rattles in shell....
中文翻译: 垃圾，外壳里有很大的咔嗒声……

原文: Appeared to be straight-forward install however when I connected it, there was an annoying,  low volume electronic ticking or beeping noise beneath the volume.  It wasn't present when sound levels were louder but if the show went silent you could hear it quite clearly.
中文翻译: 看起来安装很直接，但当我连接它时，在音量下方有一种烦人的、低音量的电子滴答声或蜂鸣声。当声音较大时它不存在，但如果节目静音了，你能很清楚地听到它。

原文: The sound is fine, not great, not horrible. There is a buzzing noise when it’s turned off but plugged in, but I just turn the radio back on anyway so that’s not an issue for me. It sticks out quite a bit from the dash but it is small. It’s easy to use, but not my fave. For the price it’s fine.
中文翻译: 声音还行，不算好，也不算差。关掉但插着电的时候有嗡嗡声，不过反正我会把收音机重新打开，所以对我来说不是问题。它从仪表盘上凸出挺多，但体积小。用起来方便，但不是我的最爱。就价格而言还行。

原文:
At first glance this product seems that it would be a good device to record lectures or talks. It does work, but the sound quality is definitely lacking.

Pros: Device is small and can be used almost anywhere.

Cons: Complicated wire-button system to get the recorder to record. Sound quality is dismal. Battery life is only 2-3 hours at most before it drains.

All in all, it does work. But other devices have better battery life and sound than this. Save your money for a better device.
中文翻译:
乍一看，这款产品似乎是一个录制讲座或谈话的好设备。它确实能用，但音质明显不足。

优点：设备小巧，几乎可以在任何地方使用。

缺点：复杂的线控按钮系统来让录音机开始录音。音质很差。电池寿命最多只有2-3小时就会耗尽。

总的来说，它确实能用。但其他设备有更好的电池寿命和音质。把钱省下来买更好的设备吧。

原文: This is undoubtably the sorriest product of it's type I have ever seen. The receiver is NOT internet ready. You have to buy a $40 LAN adapter. Then, after buying the adapter, the receiver DOES NOT support Amazon Prime. As to the operation, the unit produces less sound than the Vizio Sound Bar which it replaced. The only redeeming feature is the speaker array. They play at 100% volume with no distortion. Probably because the amp is running about 300 actual watts.  When I get my income tax refund, I will buy a receiver compatible with this speaker array. Also, caveat emptor with this seller. They stonewalled all attempts to refund my purchase and return this piece of junk. They wanted me to pay shipping both ways and add a restock fee of 20%. Then they reserved the right to deny refunding based on their opinion of the resalability of the product. I filed a complaint with Amazon, but they never responded. All in all, this was a $225 mistake. I will not ever buy another appliance/electronic device on Amazon.
中文翻译: 这无疑是我见过的同类产品中最糟糕的。接收器不支持互联网。你必须购买一个40美元的LAN适配器。然后，在购买了适配器之后，接收器不支持Amazon Prime。至于操作，该设备产生的声音比它所替换的Vizio Sound Bar还要少。唯一可取的特点是扬声器阵列。它们以100%的音量播放而没有失真。可能是因为放大器实际运行约300瓦。当我拿到所得税退款时，我会购买一个与该扬声器阵列兼容的接收器。另外，对于这个卖家要小心。他们阻挠了我所有退款和退货的尝试。他们要求我支付双向运费并加收20%的补货费。然后他们保留根据他们对产品可转售性的意见拒绝退款的权利。我向亚马逊投诉，但他们从未回应。总而言之，这是一个225美元的错误。我再也不会在亚马逊上购买任何电器/电子设备了。

原文: I purchased this off  good reviews. But my cellphone speaker is better. Plan on returning.
中文翻译: 我是看了好评才买的。但我的手机扬声器都比它好。打算退货。

原文: Does not last near as long as the original and when the charger is connected to it, it causes a buzzing sound when recording with Garageband. Overall, not a great product but decent compared to what Apple charges.
中文翻译: 它的续航远不如原装产品，而且当充电器连接到它时，用Garageband录音会产生嗡嗡声。总体而言，不是很好的产品，但相比苹果的收费还算可以。

原文: Voices lack clarity and its hard to make out what is being spoken at many instances. I connected AppleTV to eARC input of speaker and hdmi out to the TV. Still no improvement in voice quality even with Voice enhancement option turned ON.
中文翻译: 声音缺乏清晰度，很多时候很难听清在说什么。我将AppleTV连接到音箱的eARC输入，HDMI输出连接到电视。即使开启了语音增强选项，人声质量仍然没有改善。

原文: This is a handy device to have for lectures, interviews and meetings. The rechargeable battery lasts and the screen is bright and clear. The instructions are useless but it is not hard . There is a slot for a memory card and the internal memory is 8GB.  There is an app for file sharing. Sound quality is okay. I can make out pretty much everything that is said but the volume is softer than I expected. It is lightweight. Sufficient for most purposes.
中文翻译: 这是一个方便的设备，适用于讲座、采访和会议。可充电电池续航持久，屏幕明亮清晰。说明书没什么用，但并不难操作。有一个存储卡插槽，内置存储为8GB。有一个用于文件共享的应用。音质还可以。我几乎能听清所说的所有内容，但音量比我预期的要柔和。它很轻。对大多数用途来说足够了。

原文:
Pros
Decent sound for small room
Good size
Can be used as a Bluetooth speaker
Remote with batteries included
Easy and clear instructions
Wall mounting guide
Everything needed was included
Great shipping and packaging

CONS
not good bass at all
Sound isn’t good too loud
Priced too high for sound quality

This is a decent sound bar, there are more positives than negatives but I believe I paid a bit too much for it. My biggest issue is the bass, if you turn it up is just more of muffle sound rather than clear “thumping” sound. As far as the overall sound, if you keep it on a lower volume setting it sounds great but if you turn it up then it starts to sound a bit distorted. 原文:
Nice speaker, connects easily and sounds really good. It is very small as one would expect of a) a portable, water-resistant Bluetooth speaker b) any speaker at this price point; but it is more than adequate to listen to while cooking, take to the beach etc and the sound is quite good. It is a Sony which has a lot to do with why it was one of the number I considered before purchasing. I have several Sony electronics and they have proven to be reliable and of good quality. All things being equal(ish) I went with the brand I know. It has decent reviews and was very reasonably priced.

It has proven to be a good little speaker. The sound is very good and no distortion even taken as loud as it will go. I may be 63, but the tunes I have and play are Five Finger Death Punch, Halestorm, Royal Blood, Breaking Benjamin and so forth, so it gets a workout - no Bach or easy-listening milquetoast music. I am pleased so far.

My only con, and it isn’t really a dealbreaker for me, though it is VERY disappointing, is the volume level. It tops out before I wish it would. It can be played loud, but not as loud as I want/wish. I suppose it has to do with size and governing volume so as not to blow the speaker, but I have a sneaking suspicion it is like the volume control on my 2015 RAV4. It maxes out in my car, at the level Big Brother deems is the top level that is for our own good. You know, to save us from ourselves, keep us from blowing an eardrum (as if). Like headphones and earbuds do. We are too stupid to be left to run wild with that volume control!!

Besides the infuriating limit to volume level, overall I am really liking it. I haven’t had it a long time, so if anything changes I will update. So far, it is a good buy.
中文翻译:
不错的音箱，连接方便，音质听起来真的很好。它非常小，正如人们对a）便携、防水的蓝牙音箱 b）这个价位的任何音箱所预期的那样；但它足以在做饭、去海滩等时候听，而且音质相当好。它是索尼的，这很大程度上解释了为什么它是我购买前考虑的众多型号之一。我有几件索尼电子产品，它们被证明可靠且质量好。在所有条件大致相同的情况下，我选择了我熟悉的品牌。它评价不错，而且价格非常合理。

它被证明是一个不错的小音箱。音质非常好，即使开到最大音量也没有失真。我可能63岁了，但我拥有和播放的曲子是Five Finger Death Punch、Halestorm、Royal Blood、Breaking Benjamin等等，所以它得到了锻炼——不是巴赫或轻松聆听的软绵绵音乐。到目前为止我很满意。

我唯一的缺点，对我来说并不是真正的破坏因素，尽管它非常令人失望，是音量水平。它在我希望它达到之前就达到上限了。它可以播放得很大声，但没有我想要的/希望的那么大声。我想这与尺寸和控制音量以免损坏音箱有关，但我有一种暗中的怀疑，它就像我2015年RAV4上的音量控制。它在我的车里达到最大，达到老大哥认为对我们自己有利的最高水平。你知道，为了拯救我们自己，防止我们震破耳膜（好像会似的）。就像耳机和耳塞那样。我们太愚蠢了，不能放任我们随意使用那个音量控制！！

原文:
In full disclosure, I must admit that I miss my Bose Bluetooth speaker. Their acoustics are impeccable. The "Tribit XSound Go Bluetooth Speakers" only cost a fraction of my Bose speaker. I first purchased the "DOSS Touch Wireless Bluetooth" which is in the same price range; I returned that product because it lacked bass and was unimpressive overall. The Tribit, however, has plenty of bass for such a small speaker. Ironically, the problem that I have is the treble! I think it is an inherent problem with smaller speakers and not this particular device. I have installed an equalizer on my computer which mitigates some of the problems and makes the speaker sound very acceptable.

The pros:
• The speaker is loud! It is perfect for a jam session in your bedroom. I'm not sure it is suitable for large or multi rooms.
• The quality is good, and the speaker looks like a million bucks.
• It has an excellent microphone that works well with phone calls and even to interact with Siri or Cortana.
• The Play button allows one to answer, reject or end a call. It also can play or pause a song. Finally, it allows you to skip a music track forward or backward.

The cons:
• While the bass is fairly impressive, the treble is slightly overriding.
• The battery does not nearly last for 24 hours if you like to blast music as I do
• The speaker can only be paired to one device at a time. If you are listening to music on the computer and the phone tries to connect, the speaker will sometimes disconnect from all devices. The speaker does have an av input one could connect to the computer but obviously, the speaker would no longer be completely portable. This could be a deal breaker for many.

After comparing this speaker with others in its price range, I realize that this speaker has such poor sound quality that I could never recommend it to anyone.
中文翻译:
完全披露，我必须承认我怀念我的Bose蓝牙音箱。它们的音质无可挑剔。而“Tribit XSound Go蓝牙音箱”的价格只是我的Bose音箱的一小部分。我最初购买了“DOSS Touch无线蓝牙音箱”，价格范围相同；我退回了那个产品，因为它缺乏低音，整体上不令人印象深刻。然而，Tribit对于这么小的音箱来说有足够的低音。讽刺的是，我的问题是高音！我认为这是较小音箱的固有问题，而不是这个特定设备的问题。我在电脑上安装了一个均衡器，这减轻了一些问题，使音箱的声音非常可接受。

优点：
• 音箱声音很大！非常适合在卧室里开派对。我不确定它是否适合大房间或多房间。
• 质量很好，音箱看起来价值百万。
• 它有一个出色的麦克风，可以很好地用于电话通话，甚至与Siri或Cortana互动。
• 播放按钮允许接听、拒绝或结束通话。它还可以播放或暂停歌曲。最后，它允许你向前或向后跳过音乐曲目。

缺点：
• 虽然低音相当令人印象深刻，但高音略微压倒。
• 如果你像我一样喜欢大声播放音乐，电池几乎不能持续24小时。
• 音箱一次只能配对一台设备。如果你在电脑上听音乐，而手机尝试连接，音箱有时会断开所有设备。音箱确实有一个AV输入可以连接到电脑，但显然，音箱将不再完全便携。这对许多人来说可能是一个破坏交易的因素。

在将此音箱与同价位的其他音箱进行比较后，我意识到这个音箱的音质如此之差，我永远不会向任何人推荐它。

原文:
I was so excited to find this product - exactly what I needed for laptop with crappy sound - super affordable - does not take up precious desk space. But mine only worked one day!!

I tried it on different devices (ipad, iphone) to see if it was just the computer - but it's not. (Reattached my other speakers and they work with the same computer and the devices). I tried it attached and unattached to usb - I unplugged and re-plugged everything - the light is blue, but no sound. And yes, it is turned on. And yes, my volume is on max. Like I said, it worked fine the first day right out of the package. (So good in fact I had to dig through the wastebasket to find the packaging I threw away thinking I wouldn't need it). I'm really disappointed.

For the day it worked, tho, it was awesome. Good sound and plenty loud enough. Sits nicely on the top of the laptop screen and can be moved where you want it. Does not cover up webcam. (Note: it isn't firmly attached in any way - very loose fit but secure enough unless you move the computer. I would take them off for that. You also have to remove it to close the laptop). Only complaint I had (on the first day at least) was a jack cord that was almost too short. I had to move the speaker from the center top to the left end of the screen so the cord would reach the jack. Not a dealbreaker, though.

But not working at all - well that's obviously a dealbreaker. Sadly returning this.
中文翻译:
我非常兴奋地找到了这个产品——正是我需要的，用于声音很差的笔记本电脑——超级实惠——不占用宝贵的桌面空间。但我的只工作了一天！！

我在不同的设备上试过（iPad、iPhone），看看是不是只是电脑的问题——但并不是。（重新接上我的其他扬声器，它们在同一个电脑和设备上都能工作）。我试过连接和不连接USB——我拔掉并重新插上所有东西——灯是蓝色的，但没有声音。是的，它已经打开了。是的，我的音量已经调到最大。就像我说的，第一天刚从包装里拿出来时它工作得很好。（事实上好到我不得不翻垃圾桶去找我扔掉的包装，因为我觉得不需要它）。我真的很失望。

不过，在它工作的那一天，它太棒了。音质好，音量也足够大。很好地放在笔记本电脑屏幕顶部，可以移动到你想放的地方。不遮挡网络摄像头。（注意：它没有以任何方式牢固连接——非常松，但除非你移动电脑，否则足够安全。我会为此取下它们。你也必须取下它才能合上笔记本电脑）。我唯一的抱怨（至少第一天）是插孔线几乎太短了。我不得不把扬声器从顶部中央移到屏幕左端，这样线才能够到插孔。不过这不是大问题。

但完全不能工作——嗯，那显然是大问题。遗憾的是要退货了。

原文:
I just got mine, plugged it to charge and it was done in a couple of hours. Assuming they sent it with some battery life as they said it can take up to five hours when it’s dead and mine was done in under three.

I’m heading up north with it in a few days so we’ll see how it does up there and I’ll update! I’m happy I’ll have this with me👍

我刚拿到我的，插上充电，几个小时就充满了。假设他们发货时带了一些电量，因为据说没电时充满需要长达五小时，而我的不到三小时就完成了。

首先，它确实能与Alexa配合使用。我刚试过。你下载他们的应用，再简单不过了。不过在此之前，我一直在从我的亚马逊账户播放音乐。可能让人困惑的是，登录亚马逊账户后，你必须点击应用屏幕底部的横条，然后她就活过来了。她按照要求打断了我的音乐来告诉我天气，当我让她恢复我的音乐时，她照做了。而且她并没有重新开始播放。我觉得这很酷。我也没有使用亚马逊音乐的付费功能，只是免费版。

原文:
This out door antenna works pretty good. I was surprised by the size of it, but then again I wasn't really sure what to expect. It was easy enough to set up. Others have mentioned needing a cable to run it to, but ours is wifi so all we had to do was plug the cord in, power on and download the app. The app provided pretty basic instructions and what we didn't get from the app we got from the instructions that were provided. We mounted this outside of our back door to extend to the barn/game area. Normally we have a perfect connection and there is a noticeable difference in the connection and the network not coming up and down.

I only removed one star due to the instructions. Part were from the app and the other was from the instructions that were provided.
中文翻译:
这个户外天线效果相当不错。我对它的尺寸感到惊讶，不过话说回来，我本来也不确定会是什么样。设置起来挺容易的。其他人提到需要一根线缆来连接，但我们的是WiFi的，所以我们只需要插上电源线、开机并下载应用。应用提供了相当基础的说明，应用里没讲到的部分我们从附带的说明书里找到了。我们把它安装在后门外，用来延伸到谷仓/游戏区。通常我们有完美的连接，而且在连接和网络不再时断时续方面有显著差异。

我只因为说明书扣了一颗星。一部分来自应用，另一部分来自附带的说明书。
